sections.heading: What this is
sections.body: A daily habit of catching what went right. Small wins pile up — and your streak keeps the receipts.

sections.heading: The streak
sections.body: Log a win, the streak ticks up. Miss a day, it starts over — but your total never goes backwards.

sections.heading: Your wins
sections.body: Every win you log is yours, forever. My Wins shows the whole story, day by day.

sections.heading: Goals
sections.body: Set goals to point your wins somewhere. Tick them off when they're yours. Add more whenever.

sections.heading: Why no AI yet
sections.body: V1 is free and private — your wins never leave your device. Simple on purpose.
